title: The Trinity test as the hinge point that drew the phenomenon

tellings.quote: unable to destroy itself. Then on July 16th, 1945, in a stretch of New Mexico desert, Oenheimer named Trinity.

plain: The idea is that the first atomic bomb test, which Oppenheimer named Trinity and which was set off in the New Mexico desert on July 16, 1945, was the turning point that drew UFOs to Earth. Michels tells it in his own framing, opening an episode about Air Force veterans who say they were abducted. If true, the phenomenon arrived because humans had just gained the power to destroy themselves.
